title: What is Stigma Attributed to? A Theory-Grounded, Expert-Annotated Interview Corpus for Demystifying Mental-Health Stigma
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting and classifying mental-health stigma based on a social-psychological attribution model. While stigma involves social prejudice and moral judgments, the study is primarily a benchmark for social bias detection in the context of mental health rather than an evaluation of religious beliefs or philosophical moral frameworks.
